about: Made by scripts/art/hero.py from art/hero.json, art/animations.json and art/lineages.json. Do not edit by hand.

heightScale.note: Height is a uniform scale on the character's root node.

morphNote: maxJointShiftCm is how far the morph at weight 1 would move the joints if the skeleton were refitted. boneOffsets give that shift per bone in glTF model space (metres, Y up); the game may add weight * offset to the bones' rest positions for morphs that move joints. Clips do not key bone translation except on the hips and root.

looksNote: Paths are relative to this file. A skin replaces the base colour texture of the body's <body>_skin material (normalFile, when not null, replaces its normal texture). An eye colour replaces the base colour texture of <body>_eyes. A hair part is a .glb skinned to the same 53 bones, in the same order and with the same inverse bind matrices as the hero: hide the hero's primitive whose material is <body>_hair, load the part and give its mesh the hero's skeleton; set its morph weights by name as on the hero. 'shaved' has no file: hide the hair and add nothing. See docs/ART_PIPELINE.md.
